body: Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport resumed operations on October 25 after a two-week closure caused by Houthi attacks, only to come under attack again on its first day back in service. According to AFP, three explosions were heard in Riyadh in the early hours of the day, and residents received a safety alert warning of a hostile air threat.

The Saudi military said it shot down one ballistic missile and two drones fired by the Houthis toward Riyadh. The airport operator had announced the day before on X that, starting Sunday, October 25, Terminal 1 would serve domestic flights while Terminal 2 would be dedicated to international flights operated by Saudi carriers.

Whether flights have truly returned to normal remains unclear: according to flight-tracking site Flightradar24, about 60% of passenger aircraft scheduled to arrive at or depart from the airport on the morning of October 25 were cancelled. The Houthis said in a statement the same day that they would continue operations targeting the airport and warned passengers, staff and airlines not to use it.
en.summary: King Khalid International Airport resumed operations on October 25 after a two-week closure, but was attacked again on its reopening day; the Saudi military said it shot down one ballistic missile and two drones, and about 60% of that morning's scheduled passenger flights were cancelled.
en.title: Riyadh airport attacked again on reopening day; Saudi military says it shot down one missile and two drones

body: 沙烏地阿拉伯首都利雅德的哈立德國王國際機場，在因胡塞武裝攻擊而關閉2週後，於25日恢復營運，卻在重開首日再度遭到攻擊。據法新社報導，當天凌晨利雅德傳出3次爆炸聲，居民也收到提醒注意敵對空中威脅的安全警報。
沙烏地軍方表示，已擊落胡塞武裝朝利雅德發射的1枚彈道飛彈與2架無人機。機場營運方前一天透過社群平台宣布，自10月25日星期日起，第1航廈供國內線使用，第2航廈專供本國航空公司營運的國際線使用。
航班是否真正恢復正常仍不明朗：據航班追蹤網站資料，25日上午預定在該機場起降的客機中，約60％取消。胡塞武裝當天透過聲明表示，將繼續以該機場為目標的作戰，並警告旅客、職員與航空公司不要使用該機場。
zh.summary: 哈立德國王國際機場在關閉2週後於25日恢復營運，卻在重開首日再度遭到胡塞攻擊；沙烏地軍方表示擊落1枚彈道飛彈與2架無人機，25日上午預定起降的客機約60％取消。
zh.title: 利雅德機場重開首日再遭胡塞攻擊、沙烏地軍方擊落1枚飛彈與2架無人機
